_comment: Hand-curated exact trumpet-family scorings, concentrated on orchestral repertoire where IMSLP's Instrumentation field only says 'orchestra'. The 'trumpets' string is parsed by lib/instrumentation.mjs into structured counts, so it should be written naturally. Counts are players, not parts: a concerto counts the soloist and the orchestra's own section together. Transposition is never recorded — a trumpet in D and a trumpet in B-flat are both a trumpet. Cornet is kept separate from trumpet. Bass trumpet is out of scope and is mentioned only in 'full' or 'note'. 'full' summarises the surrounding brass for context. Entries here override harvested records for the same work.
